zh-CN.title: 成长，不再是一张说明书
items: 成长主页重构为五阶段成长护照，当前等级拥有完整的专属配色
任务、安全建议与成长记录改为渐进展开，重要信息一眼可见
等级图鉴现在直接预览真实背景、气泡和头像框，并支持吸附式横向浏览

en.title: Growth, redesigned
items: The Growth home is now a five-stage passport with a distinct palette for every stage
Tasks, security suggestions, and history use progressive disclosure to keep focus clear
The level atlas now previews real backgrounds, bubbles, and avatar frames in a tactile carousel
